title: Development and prognostic validation of a three-level NHG-like deep learning-based model for histological grading of breast cancer
summary: Learned WSI grader yields a clinically specific prognostic stratification and is assessed on internal and fully independent external cohort; satisfies validation for defined result. Do not infer improved clinical outcomes. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.

evidence.ai_role: routine histology WSIs from two cohorts (SöS-BC-4 N=2,421 training/internal test; SCAN-B-Lund N=1,262 external test); DL assigns three-level NHG-like grade. Prognostic recurrence-free survival analysis: grade-3 vs grade-1 HR 2.27 (95% CI 1.07–4.82, p=.033) internal after adjustment; independent cohort assessed. Specific prognostic grading result, not prospective benefit.
